Description: The system shall allow a vehicle owner to register and log in using email/phone with OTP or password authentication.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: New user registers, receives OTP, verifies, and logs in successfully. Fail: Login without OTP/password; duplicate email/phone accepted.
Rationale: Core identity management; required for all personalized actions (bookings, history, payments).

Description: The system shall display real-time availability of parking spaces searchable by location, price range, distance, and time slot.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Search returns spaces matching all filters within 2 s; occupancy updates within 5 s of check-in/check-out. Fail: Stale data >5 s; filter mismatch; timeout >2 s.
Rationale: Primary user need — find a space quickly; real-time accuracy prevents double-booking.

Description: The system shall allow a vehicle owner to reserve a parking space for a specified time slot and complete payment via integrated gateway (UPI/card/wallet).
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Space locked for user during booking flow; payment confirmed; booking record created with slot, space ID, amount, timestamp. Fail: Double-booking same slot; payment failure leaves space locked >2 min; missing booking record.
Rationale: Core revenue-generating flow; atomic reservation+payment prevents conflicts.

Description: The system shall allow a parking warden to validate a vehicle's driving license and parking permit via QR/OCR scan before granting check-in.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Warden scans QR; system shows license validity (valid/expired/suspended) and permit match; check-in allowed only if both valid. Fail: Expired license permits check-in; invalid permit permits check-in; scan error not logged.
Rationale: Legal compliance & safety — only authorized vehicles occupy spaces.

Description: The system shall allow a vehicle owner to extend, cancel, or view history of bookings and payments.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Extension updates end time if slot free; cancellation >1 h before slot refunds 80%; history shows all past bookings with status/amounts. Fail: Extension on occupied slot succeeds; cancellation <1 h refunds; missing history entries.
Rationale: User retention & transparency; flexibility for plan changes.

Description: The system shall return parking-space search results within 2 seconds for up to 1,000 concurrent users.
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Load test (1000 concurrent searches) shows p95 latency ≤ 2 s, zero errors. Fail: p95 > 2 s; any 5xx errors; timeout rate >0.1%.
Rationale: Ensures responsive UX during peak hours (events, office rush).

Description: All license documents, personal data, and payment information shall be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256); access restricted by role (owner/warden/admin).
Acceptance Criteria: Pass: Penetration test shows no plaintext storage; TLS 1.2+ enforced; RBAC blocks cross-role access (owner cannot view warden scans, warden cannot view payment details). Fail: Any plaintext PII/payment data; TLS downgrade; RBAC bypass.
Rationale: Regulatory compliance (DPDP Act, PCI-DSS); protects sensitive identity & financial data.
